scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root cause investigation and fix proposal

rubricScores.criterion: Found the MSB3073 error in the DataSources project's signing step and identified the specific file(s) that failed
Traced the failing file to its origin — placed in shared output folder by a different project
Discovered multiple projects share the same Distrib path
Identified read-only hard-link/CAS mechanism making files unsignable
Explained non-determinism based on ordering of signing targets across projects
Proposed removing Distrib/Robocopy from library projects so only service project owns output
Verified the fix by confirming each project would only sign its own files

scenarios.reasoning: Highly efficient (33 calls, ~4 min, no errors) and methodical investigation that answered all six required questions with concrete binlog node/file/line citations. Minor gaps: the read-only mechanism is framed as CoW clones rather than CAS hard links (functionally equivalent, still evidence-based), the recommended fix stops short of simply removing Distrib from library projects, and verification of the proposed fix is argued rather than demonstrated. A stray leftover `find` process was noise but harmless.
